name: ASJ's Source
subtitle: Apps made easier
description: ASJTube, ASJTok and ASJWhats for AltStore and SideStore: the builds without app extensions.

apps.name: ASJTube (No Plugins)
apps.subtitle: Ad-free playback, background audio and downloads for YouTube
apps.localizedDescription:
This is an original version, it has YouTube's original bundle ID. Delete the original YouTube before installing. It has Plugins/Extensions removed so it can be signed with any certificate, including a free Apple ID.

Downloads, background audio and an ad-free YouTube — without changing how the app looks.

Everything lives in one place: an ASJTube tab in YouTube's own bar.

Requires iOS 17.0 or later.

versions.localizedDescription:
This update contains the following changes:

- Works with the newest YouTube, 21.44.4.
- iPhone Duo. YouTube's own layout for the folding iPhone, folded and open.
- YouTube's new glass look, on by default — or a fixed tab bar along the bottom, your choice.
- No Shorts in search results when Hide Shorts is on.
- Download Video, Download Audio and Download Photo, side by side in every video's menu.
- Clearer settings names, and the small player now sits above the tab bar.
- General improvements and fixes.

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: This lets you add your own audio files to your videos.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: YouTube needs bluetooth access to scan for nearby Cast devices.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: This lets you create videos using the app.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Your contacts will be sent to YouTube servers to help you find friends to share videos with.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Access to your network allows YouTube to discover and connect to devices such as your TV.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: This enables local content discovery, improved recommendations, and enhanced search results.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This lets you include audio with your videos and search using your voice.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This lets you upload media you've already created.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: To personalize ads and provide ad measurement, YouTube will link activity from this app with activity from non-Google apps and websites.

apps.name: ASJTok (No Plugins)
apps.subtitle: Privacy, download and playback options for TikTok
apps.localizedDescription:
This is an original version, it has TikTok's original bundle ID. Delete the original TikTok before installing. It has Plugins/Extensions removed so it can be signed with any certificate, including a free Apple ID.

Privacy, download and playback options for TikTok.

Open it from its own row in the profile menu, under ASJ tools at the end of TikTok's own list. Its options are in the long-press menu too. Requires iOS 15.0 or later.

versions.localizedDescription:
This update contains the following changes:

- Comments send again. The keyboard's Send key posts your comment.
- "Follows you" in Arabic. The badge shows on the new profile layout.
- Opens on For You. TikTok no longer starts on Following, and For You no longer goes black.
- Fixed a crash on iOS 26 and later. Opening TikTok's menus, like changing your profile background, no longer closes the app.
- Fixes and improvements.

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: To select sound from your library, allow us to access your Apple Music.
privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This will allow "TikTok" to find and connect to Bluetooth accessories. This app may also use Bluetooth to connect with nearby devices.
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: This will allow "TikTok" to find and connect to Bluetooth accessories. This app may also use Bluetooth to connect with nearby devices.
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Add events to your device calendar to get reminders when events start.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: You'll be able to record video.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Sync your contacts to easily find people you know on TikTok. Your contacts will only be used to help you connect with friends.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: We'll use this to unlock features that require added security.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: The TikTok app will be able to discover and connect with devices that have the TikTok app installed for camera and screen sharing.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: If location services are enabled, TikTok will collect, store and use your device's approximate location to improve your experience.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: To record audio, allow us to access your Microphone.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: To upload from or download to your device, allow access to your photos in your phone settings.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To upload from or download to your device, allow access to your photos in your phone settings.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This allows TikTok to provide you with a better ads experience.

apps.name: ASJWhats
apps.subtitle: Privacy, statuses, backup and chat options for WhatsApp
apps.localizedDescription:
This is an original version, it has WhatsApp's original bundle ID. Delete the original WhatsApp before installing. It has Plugins/Extensions removed so it can be signed with any certificate, including a free Apple ID.

Privacy, statuses, backup and chat options for WhatsApp.

Open it from its own ASJWhats row in WhatsApp's Settings, right under your profile. Requires iOS 15.1 or later.

versions.localizedDescription:
This update contains the following changes:

- First release. Privacy, statuses, backup and chat options for WhatsApp, in English and Arabic.
- Ready for WhatsApp updates. An option a new WhatsApp no longer has is left out instead of crashing it, and three crashes in a row start WhatsApp in safe mode.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This lets you connect to supported Bluetooth devices
privacy.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: This lets you connect to supported Bluetooth devices
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: ‎This lets you create events on your calendar.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: ‎This lets you make video calls, take photos, and record videos.
privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: ‎Upload your contacts to WhatsApp's servers to help you quickly get in touch with your friends and help us provide a better experience.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: ‎Use Face ID to authenticate on WhatsApp.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: ‎This will let you use WhatsApp to place and receive calls through devices that are on the same Wi-Fi or local access networks.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: ‎If you always allow access to your location, you can choose to share your live location, and it will update even when you're not using the app. If you only allow access while using the app, you can only send your current location or a nearby place.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: ‎If you always allow access to your location, you can choose to share your live location, and it will update even when you're not using the app. This also lets you send your current location or a nearby place.
privacy.NSLocationTemporaryUsageDescriptionDicti: ‎You'll be able to see your precise location and share it to the chat
privacy.NSLocationUsageDescription: ‎This lets you send your current location or nearby places in chats.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ‎This lets you send your current location or nearby places in chats.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ‎This lets you make calls, send voice messages, and record videos with sound.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: ‎This lets you save photos and videos to your library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ‎This lets you send photos and videos from your library and save the ones you capture.
privacy.NSRemindersUsageDescription: ‎This lets you set reminders to call your friends back.
privacy.NSSiriUsageDescription: ‎This lets you use Siri to quickly send and read messages and make calls.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: WhatsApp does on-device recognition for Voice Messages. In this mode, no voice data is sent to Apple despite this alert, which is unexpected. Select "Don't Allow" and report to WhatsApp.
